notes: Fixed a real bug introduced by the v1.50.0 fleet duplicate-vehicle merge: a document (work card, insurance, registration, etc.) that had been saved under a vehicle's old plate number before that plate was merged into its current one would silently stop appearing in that vehicle's document library, because the lookup compared plates by strict equality instead of resolving old/merged plate aliases. Fixed buildFleetMap() to also index each vehicle's previous_plate_numbers, and buildVehicleDocsLibraryHtml() to match documents against the vehicle's current plate OR any of its historical plate aliases. Added a new correctness test (engine-correctness-suite.mjs) that hand-verifies a merged vehicle's document library still shows documents saved under any of its old plate numbers, and that an unrelated vehicle's documents never leak in.
